scope: Proposition 5.1 of the manuscript “Critical honeycomb chords with prescribed boundary endpoints” (preprints/Critical-honeycomb-chords-with-prescribed-boundary-endpoints-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6b7adfc0aa278ae3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let BN be the critical mass of strict bridges from one fixed port to all ports on the opposite pure cut at integral height N. With ∆fN = fN+1 − fN , for every fixed integer ℓ ≥ 0 and every η > 0 there is Cℓ,η < ∞ such that |∆ℓ BN | ≤ Cℓ,ηN−1/4−ℓ+η (N ≥ 1).
